demo_notice: Executable composite demonstration data. No real client record or live account is represented.

job.objective: Turn a signed client contract into a paid, provisioned, scheduled project without losing work between systems.
job.trigger: A contract is signed and its CRM opportunity is marked won.
definition_of_done: The signed contract is linked to the won CRM deal
The project workspace and onboarding checklist exist
Every action has a receipt and no exception remains

may_do: Read and reconcile approved client records
Create a project shell from the approved template
requires_approval: Change scope, price, or contract terms
must_never_do: Invent a client record or payment
Mark the handoff complete without source evidence

timeline.detail: Signed contract matched to the won CRM deal
Checked contract, CRM, billing, project workspace, and calendar
timeline.evidence: 5 source records read; 3 missing handoff artifacts

timeline.detail: Classified the case as a dropped post-sale handoff
timeline.evidence: contract signed + deal won + no invoice + no project + no kickoff

timeline.detail: Created the project shell and onboarding checklist
Drafted the deposit invoice and kickoff invitation
timeline.evidence: inv_1c945e6268; approval required before external send

timeline.detail: Paused at the financial and external-communication boundary
Owner approved the invoice send and kickoff invitation
Sent the deposit invoice and proposed kickoff window
Payment callback matched to the invoice and contract
Kickoff booked and all five systems reconciled
